hypothesis.valid_pairs: scenarios where both CDC values are defined (critical_required > 0)
hypothesis.decision: reject H0 if the permutation p-value < 0.05; otherwise fail to reject H0 (never accept H0)

primary_permutation_test.conclusion: Reject H0 at alpha = 0.05: the mean CDC difference (AASHRAY - FCFS) is significantly greater than 0 on the held-out set.

paired_bootstrap_ci.test_name: paired percentile bootstrap confidence interval for mean(CDC_AASHRAY - CDC_FCFS)

secondary_wilcoxon_signed_rank.zero_method: wilcox: zero differences are dropped from the ranking and counted separately
secondary_wilcoxon_signed_rank.method: normal approximation (n is large); tied absolute differences get average ranks
secondary_wilcoxon_signed_rank.statistic_name: sum of ranks of positive differences (W+)
secondary_wilcoxon_signed_rank.role: secondary; the permutation test is primary

effect_size.cohens_dz_definition: mean(delta) / sample SD(delta), ddof = 1; NaN if SD = 0
effect_size.probability_of_superiority_definition: (AASHRAY wins + 0.5 * ties) / n, paired by scenario
